newsitem.title: USA: Doe Run Co to sell $175 mln junk bonds-prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Doe Run Co to sell $175 mln junk bonds-prospectus.

text.p: Doe Run Co plans to sell $175 million in seven-year senior notes in a 144a private placement via Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette, according to a confidential prospectus obtained by Reuters.
Doe Run is the largest fully-integrated lead producer in North America, according to the document.
Net proceeds of approximately $168.2 million will be used in part to repay debt assumed when the company was purchased from Fluor Corporation in 1994, according to the prospectus.
As a result of the acquisition, all of Doe Runs' stock is owned by a company controlled by Ira Leon Rennert, the chairman of Doe Run.
Calls to DLJ were not immediately returned.
